messages.content: Vanakkam, saya Ravi dari IoT Platform team, Tenaga Nasional Berhad. Saya nak onboard 200 unit smart water meter NB-IoT untuk projek Smart City Cyberjaya. Application ID kami `app-tnb-smartcyb-01`. Boleh mulakan dengan create satu connectivity profile untuk meter ni — technology nb_iot, latency_class tolerant, priority bronze, uplink 50 kbps, max 4 mesej per jam, roaming home_only dengan home_country MY, data_format json, default callback URL https://iot.tnb.com.my/lpwan/uplink dengan bearer token.
Vanakkam Encik Ravi. Saya akan menyediakan connectivity profile NB-IoT untuk projek smart meter Cyberjaya. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

function.name: create_connectivity_profile
function.arguments: {"profile_name": "TNB-Smart-Water-Meter-Cyberjaya", "description": "NB-IoT profile for 200 smart water meters under Smart City Cyberjaya programme.", "technology": "nb_iot", "qos": {"uplink_kbps_limit": 50, "downlink_kbps_limit": 20, "max_uplink_messages_per_hour": 4, "latency_class": "tolerant", "priority": "bronze"}, "roaming": {"allowed_regions": ["MY"], "home_country": "MY", "roaming_policy": "home_only"}, "exposure": {"default_uplink_callback": {"url": "https://iot.tnb.com.my/lpwan/uplink", "auth": {"type": "bearer", "bearer": {"token": "ref:secret/tnb-iot-bearer-v3"}}, "retry_policy": {"max_retries": 3, "backoff_strategy": "exponential", "initial_delay_ms": 1000}}, "data_format": "json"}, "limits": {"max_devices": 500, "max_sessions_per_app": 10}, "labels": ["smart_city", "cyberjaya", "water_metering"]}

messages.name: create_connectivity_profile
messages.content: {"connectivity_profile_id": "cp-tnb-nbiot-cyb-01", "profile_name": "TNB-Smart-Water-Meter-Cyberjaya", "technology": "nb_iot", "status": "active", "created_at": "2026-05-21T10:02:14+08:00", "effective_qos": {"uplink_kbps_limit": 50, "latency_class": "tolerant", "priority": "bronze"}}

Bagus. Profile dah ready. Sekarang register dua device pilot dulu sebelum bulk — meter pertama IMEI 867234050098771, SIM ICCID 891060101234567890, IMSI 502152012345678, esim profile; meter kedua IMEI 867234050098772, ICCID 891060101234567891, IMSI 502152012345679. APN `tnb.iot.my`, PLMN 502-15, bind kedua-dua ke profile yang baru tu, async true.
Baik Encik Ravi, saya akan mendaftarkan kedua-dua meter perintis secara serentak dengan binding ke profile baharu.

messages.name: register_device
messages.content: {"device_id": "dev-tnb-wm-0001", "status": "provisioning", "operation_id": "op-prov-wm-0001", "warnings": []}

messages.name: register_device
messages.content: {"device_id": "dev-tnb-wm-0002", "status": "provisioning", "operation_id": "op-prov-wm-0002", "warnings": []}
Boleh check status kedua-dua operations tu, dengan include history. Saya nak tahu provisioning berjaya ke tidak.
Baik Encik, saya akan periksa status kedua-dua operasi provisioning dengan sejarah lengkap.

messages.name: get_operation_status
messages.content: {"operation_id": "op-prov-wm-0001", "state": "succeeded", "started_at": "2026-05-21T10:03:11+08:00", "ended_at": "2026-05-21T10:03:42+08:00", "history": [{"step": "validate_imei", "status": "ok"}, {"step": "create_sim_session", "status": "ok"}, {"step": "bind_profile", "status": "ok"}]}

messages.name: get_operation_status
messages.content: {"operation_id": "op-prov-wm-0002", "state": "failed", "started_at": "2026-05-21T10:03:12+08:00", "ended_at": "2026-05-21T10:03:48+08:00", "error_info": {"code": "SIM_HLR_TIMEOUT", "message": "HLR lookup timeout while attaching IMSI 502152012345679", "retryable": true}, "history": [{"step": "validate_imei", "status": "ok"}, {"step": "create_sim_session", "status": "failed"}]}
Alamak, meter kedua gagal sebab HLR timeout. Boleh retry operation tu dalam resume mode, dan validate dry_run dulu untuk pastikan ok.
Baik Encik, saya akan menjalankan dry-run terlebih dahulu untuk memastikan retry selamat.

messages.name: retry_operation
messages.content: {"operation_id": "op-prov-wm-0002", "dry_run": true, "feasible": true, "would_resume_from_step": "create_sim_session", "estimated_duration_seconds": 30}

Okay, dry-run lulus. Sekarang retry betul-betul, dan in parallel boleh open satu exposure session untuk meter pertama yang sudah berjaya tu — application sama, dengan satu policy uplink-only yang allow message_type uplink_data dan throttle ke 2 messages per minute.
Baik Encik, saya akan menjalankan retry sebenar dan membuka exposure session untuk meter pertama secara serentak.

messages.name: retry_operation
messages.content: {"operation_id": "op-prov-wm-0002", "new_state": "running", "resumed_from_step": "create_sim_session", "scheduled_at": "2026-05-21T10:05:01+08:00"}

messages.name: open_exposure_session
messages.content: {"exposure_session_id": "sess-tnb-wm-cyb-01", "application_id": "app-tnb-smartcyb-01", "applied_policies": [{"policy_id": "pol-uplink-mtr-01", "policy_name": "uplink-meter-reading-only", "direction": "uplink", "rules_count": 3}], "status": "active", "opened_at": "2026-05-21T10:05:02+08:00", "expires_at": "2026-06-20T10:05:02+08:00"}

Bagus. Sebelum saya teruskan, boleh subscribe satu webhook supaya pasukan saya dapat semua lifecycle events session ni. Transport webhook, URL https://iot.tnb.com.my/lpwan/events, HMAC-SHA256 signing, max 5 retries exponential, dead letter ke `dlq:lpwan-events`.
Baik Encik, saya akan menyediakan langganan webhook dengan tandatangan HMAC dan dasar percubaan eksponensial.

messages.name: subscribe_to_exposure_session_events
messages.content: {"subscription_id": "sub-tnb-wh-01", "status": "active", "verified": true, "created_at": "2026-05-21T10:06:18+08:00", "endpoint_health": "reachable"}

Sekarang saya nak push satu downlink ke meter pertama tu untuk minta reading sample. Payload hex `01A0`, f_port 10, encoding hex, confirmed true, expire after 600 seconds. Lepas tu monitor health device dengan last_1h preset.
Baik Encik, saya akan menghantar mesej downlink konfirmasi dan menyemak kesihatan peranti secara serentak.

messages.name: push_downlink_message
messages.content: {"queued_messages": [{"device_id": "dev-tnb-wm-0001", "message_id": "msg-dl-001", "queued_at": "2026-05-21T10:07:01+08:00", "expected_delivery": "on_next_uplink_window"}], "policy_evaluation": {"verdict": "allow", "applied_rules": ["allow:f_port=10"]}, "rejections": []}

messages.name: monitor_device_health
messages.content: {"device_id": "dev-tnb-wm-0001", "connectivity_status": "online", "last_seen": "2026-05-21T10:06:54+08:00", "battery": {"voltage_v": 3.42, "percent": 88}, "rf_metrics": {"rsrp_dbm": -94, "rsrq_db": -11, "sinr_db": 12}, "error_events_24h": 0, "downlink_queue": {"length": 1, "oldest_age_seconds": 12}}

Device sihat. Saya perasan policy `uplink-meter-reading-only` ada satu rule yang saya nak update — naikkan max_messages_per_minute dari 2 ke 5 sebab pilot phase kami perlu sampling lebih cepat. Boleh update policies session dan capture audit reason `pilot phase sampling uplift`.
Baik Encik, saya akan mengemas kini polisi session dengan had baharu serta merekod alasan audit.

messages.name: update_exposure_policies
messages.content: {"exposure_session_id": "sess-tnb-wm-cyb-01", "updated_policies": [{"policy_id": "pol-uplink-mtr-01", "enabled": true, "version": 2}], "warnings": [], "applied_at": "2026-05-21T10:08:35+08:00"}
Bagus. Sekarang saya nak tarik session status full include semua, kemudian list semua devices yang status active pada profile kita ni untuk verify inventory.
Baik Encik, saya akan menarik status session penuh dan inventori peranti aktif secara serentak.

messages.name: get_exposure_session_status
messages.content: {"exposure_session_id": "sess-tnb-wm-cyb-01", "state": "active", "devices": [{"device_id": "dev-tnb-wm-0001", "join_status": "joined"}], "policies": [{"policy_id": "pol-uplink-mtr-01", "version": 2, "enabled": true}], "metrics": {"uplinks_last_1h": 18, "downlinks_last_1h": 1, "policy_violations_last_1h": 0}, "callbacks": {"uplink": {"url": "https://iot.tnb.com.my/lpwan/uplink", "success_rate_pct": 100.0}}}

messages.name: list_devices
messages.content: {"devices": [{"device_id": "dev-tnb-wm-0002", "status": "provisioning", "imei": "867234050098772"}, {"device_id": "dev-tnb-wm-0001", "status": "active", "imei": "867234050098771", "last_seen": "2026-05-21T10:08:50+08:00"}], "pagination": {"page": 1, "page_size": 50, "total": 2}}

Sebab pilot dah jalan elok, sekarang nak persediakan rollout 198 meter baki. Saya nak bulk_create exposure sessions — anggap satu group session sahaja untuk semua meter Cyberjaya, kita guna best_effort mode dengan dedup client_ref. Tapi sebelum tu, simulate dulu impact change scaling ni untuk session sedia ada.
Baik Encik, saya akan menjalankan simulasi penskalaan terlebih dahulu sebelum kita memutuskan pelan rollout.

messages.name: simulate_exposure_session_changes
messages.content: {"simulation_id": "sim-sess-cyb-001", "impact_estimate": {"projected_uplinks_per_hour": 800, "projected_downlinks_per_hour": 60, "cost_delta_myr_per_month": 1240, "capacity_headroom_pct_after": 62}, "blast_radius": {"affected_devices": 200, "affected_callbacks": 2}, "explain": "200 meters at 5 msg/min worst-case stays within profile cap; webhook endpoint p99 latency 240ms acceptable."}

Nampak okay. Lihat throttle 8 kotor sikit, jom kekal kat 5 sahaja. Boleh tag session ni sebagai `pilot_validated` dan `phase2_ready`, kemudian request approval dari Encik Faiz (Network Director) sebab kami nak commit budget MYR 1,240 sebulan tambahan.
Baik Encik, saya akan menandakan session sebagai siap fasa 2 dan menghantar permintaan kelulusan kepada Encik Faiz.

function.name: request_exposure_session_approval
function.arguments: {"target_id": "sess-tnb-wm-cyb-01", "change_summary": "Approve phase 2 rollout of 198 additional NB-IoT smart water meters across Cyberjaya. Additional OPEX MYR 1,240/month per simulation sim-sess-cyb-001.", "approvers": [{"stage": 1, "kind": "user", "id": "faiz.abdullah@tnb.com.my", "role": "Network Director", "min_required": 1}], "evidence_refs": ["sim-sess-cyb-001", "sess-tnb-wm-cyb-01"], "due_at": "2026-05-22T17:00:00+08:00"}

messages.name: tag_exposure_sessions
messages.content: {"updated": [{"target_id": "sess-tnb-wm-cyb-01", "tags_after": ["pilot_validated", "phase2_ready"]}], "applied_at": "2026-05-21T10:11:21+08:00"}

messages.name: request_exposure_session_approval
messages.content: {"approval_request_id": "appr-sess-cyb-001", "status": "pending", "approvers_notified": ["faiz.abdullah@tnb.com.my"], "expires_at": "2026-05-22T17:00:00+08:00"}

Sebelum saya tutup call, saya nak satu meter pilot tu (wm-0001) di-suspend buat sementara waktu untuk maintenance fizikal yang dijadualkan esok pagi 6 pagi sampai 8 pagi. Suspend untuk specific_session sahaja, dengan effective_until 8 pagi esok.
Baik Encik, saya akan menggantung peranti WM-0001 dalam skop session sahaja sehingga 8 pagi esok.

function.name: suspend_or_resume_device
function.arguments: {"device_id": "dev-tnb-wm-0001", "action": "suspend", "scope": "specific_session", "exposure_session_id": "sess-tnb-wm-cyb-01", "reason": "Scheduled physical maintenance window 06:00-08:00 MYT on 2026-05-22.", "effective_until": "2026-05-22T08:00:00+08:00", "notify_application": true}

messages.name: suspend_or_resume_device
messages.content: {"device_id": "dev-tnb-wm-0001", "action": "suspend", "effective_state": "suspended", "auto_resume_at": "2026-05-22T08:00:00+08:00", "notified_endpoints": ["https://iot.tnb.com.my/lpwan/lifecycle"]}

Last thing — generate satu executive PDF report untuk sesi pilot ni (kos, kesihatan, polisi versi) dan export semua exposure sessions kami ke S3 bucket `tnb-iot-archive`, prefix `cyberjaya/2026-05-21`, CSV gzip.
Baik Encik, saya akan menjana laporan eksekutif dan mengeksport data ke S3 secara serentak untuk arkib jabatan.

messages.name: generate_exposure_session_report
messages.content: {"report_id": "rpt-sess-cyb-001-exec", "format": "pdf", "download_url": "https://reports.taas.my/r/rpt-sess-cyb-001-exec.pdf", "generated_at": "2026-05-21T10:14:21+08:00"}

messages.name: export_exposure_sessions
messages.content: {"export_job_id": "exp-sess-tnb-001", "estimated_rows": 1, "signed_url": "s3://tnb-iot-archive/cyberjaya/2026-05-21/exp-sess-tnb-001.csv.gz", "status": "succeeded"}

Berikut ringkasan akhir sesi pilot TNB Cyberjaya, Encik Ravi:

- **Connectivity profile:** `cp-tnb-nbiot-cyb-01` (NB-IoT, bronze, tolerant)
- **Pilot devices:** WM-0001 aktif (dalam suspend penyelenggaraan sehingga 8 pagi esok), WM-0002 sedang retry selepas isu HLR
- **Exposure session:** `sess-tnb-wm-cyb-01` aktif, polisi versi 2 (throttle 5 msg/min)
- **Webhook subscription:** `sub-tnb-wh-01` aktif untuk lifecycle events
- **Pendekatan fasa 2:** kelulusan menunggu Encik Faiz (`appr-sess-cyb-001`)
- **Laporan PDF:** [rpt-sess-cyb-001-exec.pdf](https://reports.taas.my/r/rpt-sess-cyb-001-exec.pdf)
- **Eksport CSV:** `s3://tnb-iot-archive/cyberjaya/2026-05-21/exp-sess-tnb-001.csv.gz`

Adakah ada apa-apa lagi yang saya boleh bantu?
Cukup buat masa ini, terima kasih banyak atas bantuan.
Sama-sama, Encik Ravi. Terima kasih atas kesabaran. Kami akan maklumkan Encik sebaik sahaja WM-0002 berjaya disahkan dan kelulusan Encik Faiz diterima. Selamat tengah hari.
